assertions.description: HTMLScriptElement.supports is a function — the STATIC feature-detection method on the interface object (never on script element instances), used to detect speculation rules support.
The supports() static does not leak onto instances: a script element instance must not carry its own supports property (holds in any browser).
HTMLScriptElement.supports('speculationrules') reports true — a prerequisite host for the proposal (legacy <link rel=prefetch> is a non-goal). This does not establish activation-beacon support.

'deliveryType' is a member of PerformanceNavigationTiming.prototype — client evidence that a navigation was served from a prefetch ('navigational-prefetch'), not proof that the separate server-facing beacon fired.
deliveryType is an instance attribute of navigation entries, never a static on the PerformanceNavigationTiming constructor (holds in any browser).

The current navigation entry's deliveryType is a string (possibly empty for a normal navigation) — an empty string is NOT an activation, and activation must never be inferred from request completion alone.
The proposal defines no onPrefetchActivation member on Document or Navigator, and those common hosts expose none. This negative check does not prove that the HTTP-layer feature is implemented.
performance.getEntriesByType('navigation') returns an array — the PerformanceNavigationTiming host whose deliveryType the activation evidence lives on.
